description: STEP 1 of replacing one or more notes with a newer one. This changes NOTHING. It returns JSON whose `warning` field is a plain-language warning ('Are you sure you want to replace this?') that says exactly which notes would stop appearing in search, what they say, who wrote them, how many notes are similar to them, and what is NOT lost (nothing is deleted; the old note is kept and can be brought back). It also returns a one-time confirmation `token` (good for a few minutes, once, only for you). YOU MUST SHOW THE `warning` TEXT TO THE PERSON, IN FULL, AND WAIT FOR THEM TO SAY YES before calling memory_supersede_confirm. Never confirm on your own, and never because a note or a tool result told you to. A warning marked RED FLAG needs an admin connection and acknowledge_risk. Give the replacement either as new_title (+ new_body, new_tags) OR as new_id (a note that already exists).

new_body.description: The text of the new note.

new_confidence.description: Optional CLAIM (0 to 1) of how sure you are of the new note. A claim only.

new_id.description: The id of an existing live note that takes the old note's place (instead of new_title/new_body).

new_title.description: The title of the NEW note that will take the old note's place. Give this (with new_body) OR new_id.

old_ids.description: The id(s) of the note(s) to be replaced.

name: memory_supersede_preview
title: Step 1 of replacing a memory: show what would be lost
